the kinematics of the nuclear region in M104 is the result of a superposition of two different components: a "cold" component (the stellar disk), which dominates the kinematics within 0.2", and a "hot", pressure-supported, component (the bulge), which dominates the dynamics of the nuclear region at larger distances.
